product_one_liner.value: Bizagi provides a low-code platform for enterprises to automate and orchestrate business processes, connecting people, systems, data, AI and bots.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its low-code process automation and orchestration platform, the systems it connects, and its enterprise application focus. Sources: https://www.bizagi.com/company and https://www.bizagi.com/

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes Bizagi's consumption-based pricing. Source: https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Both organizations are named on Bizagi's customer case-study page. Source: https://www.bizagi.com/en/customers | named_customers.0: Unilever International is named on the customer case-study page. | named_customers.1: DHL Group is named on the customer case-study page.

employee_band.notes: Bizagi's company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees; the separately reported count of 439 falls within that band. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/bizagi and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bizagi/__gLrssBoIYRKDIbzRKSDwVcFuvVdYGxKGoreuKlClNCw

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Bizagi explicitly calls its corporate headquarters Washington DC. Its listed street address is in Tysons, Virginia, so this uses the company's headquarters-city designation rather than the physical municipality. Sources: https://www.bizagi.com/en/bizagi-faqs and https://www.bizagi.com/en/about/offices | hq_country: The company identifies its corporate headquarters as Washington DC, with a Tysons, Virginia street address; its company profile identifies that address as US. This prioritizes the company's corporate-headquarters designation over conflicting third-party UK location data. Sources: https://www.bizagi.com/en/about/offices and https://linkedin.com/company/bizagi

founded_year.notes: Bizagi's company history explicitly dates its founding to 1989. Source: https://www.bizagi.com/en/about

eng_blog.notes: The rendered blog index lists business-oriented AI, process automation, digital transformation and product-news posts, rather than two identifiable engineer-authored accounts of how Bizagi is built. This supports false under the specified index-based rule. Source: https://www.bizagi.com/en/blog

public_docs.notes: The public product documentation contains an AI-approach article and links to distinct articles covering AI Agents, AI Workers and Ask Ada. Source: https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/bizagi-ai-approach.htm

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is titled AI‑First Full Stack Developer (.NET / Angular / Azure) and has an Apply link, meeting the specified AI-in-title criterion. Source: https://bizagi.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/Bizagi_Career_Site/job/Bogota/Fullstack-Developer_JR676-1

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure OpenAI, including Azure's Private OpenAI GPT service.
model_provider.notes: The product documentation explicitly states that Bizagi embeds Azure's Private OpenAI GPT service and uses models supplied through Microsoft Azure. Source: https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/bizagi-ai-approach.htm

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The compliance page states ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and independently reviewed compliance with HIPAA/HITECH requirements. GDPR is excluded because its wording describes features enabling customer compliance, rather than a certification or direct compliance claim for Bizagi. Source: https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/compliance | compliance_certs.0: Bizagi explicitly states ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification. | compliance_certs.1: Bizagi states that independent reviews concluded Bizagi Cloud meets HIPAA/HITECH requirements; this is a compliance claim, not a formal HIPAA certificate.

launched_6mo.notes: Bizagi announced its Summer 2026 platform release on July 21, within six months of November 9, 2026. Features included embedding Ask Ada charts and insights into business apps, a substantive capability rather than a bug fix. Source: https://www.bizagi.com/resources/newsroom/summer-2026-release

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Samir Gulati's profile lists his Bizagi Chief Marketing Officer role ending in April 2026, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/samirgulati
